messages.markdown:
# UGC Proof Styles for Collagen & Greens Supplements

Across 311 evaluated short-form videos (TikTok and Instagram Reels, 17 Sep–17 Oct 2026), five proof styles were scored present/absent per video and ranked by reach.

1. **First-5-second proof wins reach:** only 49 of 311 videos (15.8%) show a result, test or measurable claim in the first five seconds, but their median of 1,531 views is 2.1× the 727 median of videos without it — brief creators to open on the receipt.
2. **Expert cameos are rare and efficient:** 30 of 311 videos (9.6%) have a dietitian, doctor or trainer on camera, with a median of 1,098 views versus 757 without — use independent credentials for one-line verdicts.
3. **Naming the ingredient or dose lifts distribution:** 159 of 311 videos (51.1%) name an ingredient or dose, median 1,034 views versus 608 without — specificity beats vague wellness claims.
4. **On-camera takes are common but not a reach lever alone:** 130 of 311 videos (41.8%) mix, pour or take the product on camera (median 698 vs 854 absent) — keep the glass demo for conversion, not discovery.
5. **Offers are scarce and sit below the median:** 35 of 311 videos (11.3%) mention a subscription, code or bundle (median 696 vs 794 absent) — place codes after proof, not before it.

prompts.label: Write three UGC briefs for collagen
prompts.prompt: Use the strongest proof styles from this research to write three UGC briefs for a collagen powder launch.

response.markdown:
Three briefs from 311 evaluated videos:

**Brief 1 — Open on proof.** First-5-second proof is only 49/311 (15.8%) but median 1,531 views vs 727 without. Copy @teffcasas (456,616 views): same-angle, same-light Day 1 vs Day 30 split in second 0-2, date overlay, then scoop.

**Brief 2 — Expert one-liner + dose.** Expert on camera is 30/311 (9.6%), median 1,098 views; naming dose is 159/311 (51.1%), median 1,034 views. Copy @doctormyro (290,805 views) and @dr.williamwallace (227,028 views): independent clinician states “10g peptides,” verdict in one line.

**Brief 3 — Glass demo.** Product taken on camera is 130/311 (41.8%). Copy @itssummerpark (601,468 views): clear glass mix, dissolve close-up, first sip, code only after proof.

prompts.label: Compare expert cameos and honest reviews
prompts.prompt: Compare the expert-cameo videos with the honest-review videos in this research. Which earns more reach, and why?

response.markdown:
**Expert cameos earn more median reach; honest reviews earn more comments.**

- Expert on camera is **30/311 present**, median **1,098 views** vs 757 absent. Top: @doctormyro (290,805 views), @drbergofficial (134,945 views), @healthyshyla (34,804 views). Authority + dose verdicts get distribution.
- Honest-review section (20 videos) is built for interaction, not median reach. Top comment drivers: @jules_horn (123,527 views, 5,312 comments), @devonlevesque (106,530 views, 3,516 comments), @dewwwdropzzz (156,302 views, 528 comments).

**Why:** credentials expand cold reach; drawback-first framing (not-sponsored, taste/price complaint) trades some reach for trust and comment depth. Brief experts for discovery, honest reviewers for conversion.

prompts.label: Find creators worth briefing
prompts.prompt: Which creators in this research appear more than once? List them with their best-performing hook.

response.markdown:
Five creators show up more than once in this research. Their best-performing hooks:

- @healthyshyla — 34,804 views; hook: dietitian fiber reaction, present in first 5 seconds.
- @rphreviews — 15,617 views; hook: copper-peptide ingredient verdict on camera.
- @heyjeffreyshouse — 54,571 views; hook: greens smoothie glass demo.
- @moralaqueteenamora — 39,320 views; hook: counterfeit-collagen warning.
- @danasia.shuntaeee — 19,943 views; hook: post-gym collagen take.

Brief them first: each already has a hook that earned reach in this niche.

sections.title: Top videos
sections.why: The 40 highest-reach videos answering the brief, ranked by fit across proof, product visibility and niche reach.

sections.title: Day-by-day diaries that cut to day 30
sections.why: Creators film the same angle every few days and jump to the end, so the timeline does the convincing, not the script.

sections.title: Dietitian and doctor cameos
sections.why: A credentialed voice reacts to the product in one line, strongest when the expert is not the brand's own.

sections.title: Ingredient demos in a glass
sections.why: Powders mixed on camera show texture, colour and the first sip, the format greens brands lean on.

sections.title: Honest reviews that name a downside
sections.why: Reviews open with a complaint or a not-sponsored line then land on a recommendation, and they draw the most comments.
